2607.19305.title: Riemannian Deep Learning: Modules, Networks, and Geometries
2607.19305.paper_summary: Deep neural networks on manifold-valued representations have attracted growing interest, but many basic components remain tied to specific manifolds, rely on Euclidean approximations, or require costly and numerically fragile geometric operations. This thesis develops a unified framework for Riemannian deep learning from three complementary perspectives: reusable neural modules, manifold-specific network architectures, and the design of underlying geometries. It generalizes batch normalization from Euclidean spaces and individual manifolds to broad classes of Lie groups and gyrogroups, and extends multinomial logistic regression from Euclidean space to SPD manifolds and then to general Riemannian manifolds. It further develops neural networks for several important geometric representations, including an unconstrained model of hyperbolic space, Busemann-based hyperbolic learning, and full-rank correlation matrices. Finally, it introduces adaptive and computationally efficient Riemannian metrics on SPD manifolds, including learnable Log-Euclidean geometries and fast, stable Cholesky-based geometries. The proposed methods are supported by theoretical analysis and validated through numerical experiments and applications in vision, signal processing, graph learning, and genomics.
2607.19305.paper_summary_zh: 深度神經網絡在流形值表示上的研究引起了越來越多的關注，但許多基本組件仍然與特定流形相連，依賴於歐幾里得近似，或需要昂貴且數值上脆弱的幾何運算。這篇論文從三個互補的角度發展了一個統一的黎曼深度學習框架：可重用的神經模塊、特定流形的網絡架構，以及基礎幾何的設計。它將批量正規化從歐幾里得空間和個別流形推廣到廣泛的李群和旋轉群，並將多項式邏輯回歸從歐幾里得空間擴展到SPD流形，然後再到一般的黎曼流形。它進一步為幾個重要的幾何表示發展了神經網絡，包括一個無約束的雙曲空間模型、基於布塞曼的雙曲學習，以及全秩相關矩陣。最後，它在SPD流形上引入了自適應且計算高效的黎曼度量，包括可學習的對數歐幾里得幾何和快速、穩定的基於喬列斯基的幾何。所提出的方法得到了理論分析的支持，並通過數值實驗以及在視覺、信號處理、圖學習和基因組學中的應用得到了驗證。
